title: Security: The serialized data is corrupted because the return value is always true.
description_snippet:
The serialized data is corrupted because the return value is always true.

Look at the call stack about serializing an ImageData object using V8ScriptValueSerializer
https://cs.chromium.org/chromium/src/third_party/blink/renderer/bindings/core/v8/serialization/v8_script_value_serializer.cc?rcl=7f
